arguments.message:
To get back in, open **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**, tap **Reset**, and then set it up again just like a first‑time enrolment:
1. Scan the new QR code with your authenticator app.
2. Enter the six‑digit code it generates to confirm.
If you can’t reach the settings page because you don’t have a working code, use one of your saved recovery codes to sign in and then reset from there. After you re‑enrol, the old QR code and its codes will no longer work.
